import sys

def can(w, m):
    if m == 0:
        return True
    if w == 1 or w == -1:
        while True:
            pass
    r = m % w
    if r == 0 or r == 1:
        return can(w, m // w)
    if r == w - 1:
        return can(w, (m + 1) // w)
    return False

def solve():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    w = int(data[0])
    m = int(data[1])
    result = "YES" if can(w, m) else "NO"
    sys.stdout.write(result)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()
